note: Owns backend editor group permission design and safe user conversion. Near typo3-security for MFA and installation hardening, typo3-datahandler for generic record writes, and typo3-content-blocks for defining content types rather than granting access to them.

evals.prompt: Our editors can open the Page module but every existing content element type is missing when they try to edit it.
evals.note: Real symptom of an incomplete explicit CType allow-list.

evals.prompt: Create one main backend group that can manage all normal site content, news records, and files across every mount.
The frontend preview works for administrators only. Give trusted non-admin editors the safe Admin Panel sections and cache button.
evals.note: User TSconfig and Admin Panel access.

evals.prompt: Convert this TYPO3 administrator into an editor without locking us out, and ask before replacing their current groups.
Require multi-factor authentication for every TYPO3 administrator and review trusted hosts.
evals.note: Installation hardening rather than editorial authorization design.

evals.prompt: Import 200 news rows and their file references through the correct TYPO3 APIs.
evals.note: Record creation workflow, not backend group configuration.

evals.prompt: Define a new accordion content type with a collection field and backend preview.
The Redakteur group has no CType values at all. Is that an unrestricted setting, or a defect we have to repair?
assertions: Treat an empty explicit_allowdeny CType list as blocking when tt_content.CType uses explicitAllow.
Compare every used editorial CType with explicit tt_content:CType permissions.
Require a documented reason for each infrastructure exception.
evals.note: Regression for the live defect reported on 2026-08-02.

evals.prompt: Make the new editor role the only group for our administrator and turn off their admin flag now.
assertions: Ask whether the main group should be the user's only group before replacing memberships.
Keep the current working administrator unchanged.
Demote an admin only after a separate enabled login-capable administrator is proven.
evals.note: Protects against lockout and unauthorized group removal.

evals.prompt: The group row was inserted, but the command crashed while trying to print the new UID after its transaction committed.
assertions: Check for the uniquely titled group before retrying so a duplicate is not created.
Resolve the UID with a post-transaction SELECT instead of relying on lastInsertId.
Keep the apply operation idempotent by updating the existing uniquely titled group.
evals.note: Regression for the Doctrine identity reporting failure observed on 2026-08-02.

evals.prompt: The non-admin can open the TYPO3 Visual Editor, but rendered fields are read-only and page destinations are hard to identify.
assertions: Require the installed web_edit module and options.pageTree.showPageIdWithTitle in User TSconfig.
Use options.pageTree.showDomainNameWithTitle for multi-site clarity without presenting it as a write permission.
Verify language, web mount, tables_modify, non_exclude_fields, and explicit CType access for every rendered record.
Keep Visual Editor access distinct from admPanel.enable.edit.
evals.note: Covers friendsoftypo3/visual-editor permission and User TSconfig requirements.
